result.fail_reason: AC4 is not met. The query-error-banner shows 'Unprocessable Entity' (the RFC 9457 title) rather than the specific field name from the 422 rejection. The unit test TC-ELBP-02 masks this by directly setting ApiError.message to the field-specific string, bypassing the real client.ts mapping. RELEASE-VALIDATOR independently traced the full chain: render_query_error/2 → Response.unprocessable/2 → Error.unprocessable/1 → RFC 9457 body with title='Unprocessable Entity' and detail='field is not queryable: ...' → client.ts throwOnErrorResponse: message = body['title'] = 'Unprocessable Entity' → extractMessage returns 'Unprocessable Entity' → banner does not name the field.
result.recommended_fix: Option A (minimal): In EntityListBrowserPage.tsx, update extractMessage to: const detail = (err as ApiError).details?.detail; return (typeof detail === 'string' && detail.length > 0) ? detail : String((err as ApiError).message). Option B (broader): In client.ts throwOnErrorResponse generic branch, use body['detail'] ?? body['title'] ?? body['message'] ?? response.statusText for message. Also update TC-ELBP-02 mock to use the real RFC 9457 shape { title: 'Unprocessable Entity', detail: "..." } and assert bannerText contains the field-specific detail, not a hand-crafted message string.
